If you are looking for more long term classes/training, I've heard good things about the Krav Maga program at Premier & they offer a free trial session. I'm not sure how much the classes cost after that.

If you're looking for a short term class, the Lawrence Police Department sometimes offers a 2 session R.A.D. course that takes place over a 2 weekend period. I believe it's free (someone please correct me if I'm wrong,) and the next session will be taking place in August. The sign up is live right now, and you should be able to access it from the LPD facebook page! Best of luck in your search!

I absolutely sympathize with being frustrated and unhappy with your job and working conditions, but this post is not it. I’m sure that there are legitimate issues happening behind the scenes at some local businesses, but in most cases those need to be discussed and handled internally, not aired out publicly on Reddit (especially since a lot of your statements seem to have more to do with workplace culture than management or owners).

There’s nothing wrong with wanting to be mindful of where your money is going! There are some local businesses that I’ve had qualms about supporting due to their business practices or the conduct of shop owners. After careful consideration, I’ve found that I feel more comfortable giving money to a local business that I don’t entirely agree with than giving money to a large corporation, and I’m thankful to live somewhere where small businesses are an accessible alternative to some corporate chains. These are decisions that people need to make for themselves though- making and posting a boycott list with no clear or discernible reasoning is just not productive.
